name: Deepdelver Myra
desc:
Deepdelver Myra is a Tiran NPC. She is a Deepdelver of [The Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union).

Myra has an upcoming scheduled expedition into the [Second Layer](location:second_layer), but is rather hesitant about the affair, as the previous expedition had not gone as planned.
additional_info:
-   Deepdelver Myra has a unique face and pose.
-   Myra's hair can be found here: https://www.roblox.com/catalog/18911919363/Black-Windy-Wispy-Anime-Hair
